change: Persistent 1x/2x/4x/8x pacing with muted accelerated output, quick pause-menu control and speed overlay

behavior.default: 1x; preference formats 1-4 migrate to normal speed without changing other preferences
behavior.persistence: PhoneOptions version 5; guest MachineState format remains 1
behavior.sound: Drain original guest PCM at every frame; do not send packets above 1x. Reset pending/active output on setting changes. At 1x output resumes according to independent user Mute setting. Guest audio registers/clocks remain unchanged.
behavior.presentation: Submit every (frameSkip+1)*speed guest frames, including first frame after reset; all guest CPU/PPU/audio work still executes. Frame skip defaults to 0.
behavior.counters: GBA FPS counts all guest frames against wall time; draw FPS counts distinct frames painted. Speed badge shows selected target factor even with FPS off.
behavior.transitions: Rebase wall/guest deadline and rate origins on pause/resume or settings changes; state loading preserves frontend speed preference.
behavior.deadlines: Integer quotient/remainder calculation avoids cycles*1000 overflow; tested against independent BigInteger arithmetic through Long.MAX_VALUE
behavior.ui: Pause / Speed cycles upward; Display & audio / Speed accepts both directions; FPS, speed and shoulder badges occupy separate rows

validation.native_session: Actual session with host adapters: initial 2x then 1x/4x/1x/8x/1x/1x+Mute; packet submission remains absent in accelerated/muted modes and resumes at normal speed. Save/load covers a change from 1x to 4x.
validation.sdk_and_rapc: Passed; JDE 7.1 / ECJ 4.6.1, numeric 0.9.0 development COD/JAD

captures.method: Production menu/renderer via headless Java2D, 640x480; tools/capture-phone-gallery.sh target/phone-gallery-scenes target/speed-gallery

speed_overlay.title: Golden Sun: The Lost Age
speed_overlay.scaling: Fit; nearest neighbor; full canvas; no menu/header/footer
speed_overlay.speed_overlay: Production renderer at selected 4x, FPS off; original captured game checkpoint, not a measured accelerated playback run

limitations: Selected factors are pacing targets limited by available CPU, not measured BlackBerry speed. SDK/API validation and host doubles do not establish actual MMAPI playback behavior or physical-device performance.
release_policy: No tag or release ZIP created; source delivery only until the user approves this release.
